data.title: Top Wall Street Forecasters Revamp Bending Spoons Expectations Ahead Of Q3 Earnings
data.description: Bending Spoons reports Q3 results Nov. 20, with estimates of 32¢ EPS and $745.7M revenue. Berkshire invested $330M, taking a 4% stake.

data.title: BJ's Wholesale Club Gears Up For Q3 Print; Here Are The Recent Forecast Changes From Wall Street's Most Accurate Analysts

data.title: Elon Musk’s Dream Meets Wall Street Reality: SpaceX Lenders Don’t Want Nvidia Chips Leaving Earth
data.description: Lenders seek limits on SpaceX launching NVDA chips financed by $43B debt, fearing collateral loss if Musk’s orbital data-center plans fail.
